ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (white) on lateral lobes and 35% low-intensity (black) concentrated in the central axial region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity (black) 'V' shaped region extending from the peduncle to the median notch; lateral white lobes contain high-frequency dark speckling/mottling at the boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an approximate internal angle of 70-80 degrees relative to the axial midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration profile; medium-frequency variations with amplitudes of 10-20 pixels visible across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge from the notch, transitioning to convex curves toward the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, high-contrast brown and white clusters localized specifically at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions visible on the inner-left white lobe area; horizontal striations visible within the central black region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization at the terminal ends of the fluke lobes; several circular puncture-like depressions visible within the central pigmented area.
